searchText: Eth-mag discussion - https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eth-config-json-rpc-method/23183 PR for EIP - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9493 My proposal is that we keep this channel for future fork config comparisons once teams adopt. At least for mainnet and testnets, possibly devnets. If teams do not adopt by the time Osaka deploys on mainnet, then archive this channel.
